description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between sample token count and scaled pair-wise two sample statistics for different intents. The x-axis is labeled “Sample Token Count” and has a logarithmic scale, ranging from 2<sup>10</sup> to 2<sup>20</sup>, with tick labels at intervals of 2<sup>11</sup>, 2<sup>13</sup>, 2<sup>15</sup>, 2<sup>17</sup>, 2<sup>19</sup>. The y-axis is labeled “Scaled Pair-wise Two Sample Statistics” and has a linear scale, ranging from 2.0 to 6.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. 

The line representing “Intent” is colored red and solid; it begins at approximately 5.7 at 2<sup>10</sup>, declines to 4.2 at 2<sup>13</sup>, then rises to 5.3 at 2<sup>20</sup>. The line for “Summary” is colored orange and solid; it starts at 5.2 at 2<sup>10</sup>, decreases to 3.2 at 2<sup>13</sup>, and increases to 5.0 at 2<sup>20</sup>. The “Law” line is colored yellow and solid, beginning at 4.8 at 2<sup>10</sup>, decreasing to 3.0 at 2<sup>13</sup>, and increasing to 4.8 at 2<sup>20</sup>. The “Translation” line is colored teal and solid, starting at 5.1 at 2<sup>10</sup>, decreasing to 3.5 at 2<sup>13</sup>, and increasing to 5.2 at 2<sup>20</sup>. The “Code” line is colored purple and solid, beginning at 3.8 at 2<sup>10</sup>, decreasing to 2.8 at 2<sup>13</sup>, and increasing to 4.2 at 2<sup>20</sup>. Finally, the “Math” line is colored green and solid, starting at 3.5 at 2<sup>10</sup>, decreasing to 2.5 at 2<sup>13</sup>, and increasing to 3.8 at 2<sup>20</sup>.
